description: Diagnostic flowchart for handling damaged inserts detected in input products before they enter the automated assembly process.

box_1.text: Are the faulty/damaged parts also found in the input product?

box_2.text: Check in both supply conveyors whether the found defects can also be found here.

box_3.text: Continue with a different batch and notify the quality assurance team.

box_4.text: Do the defects/damages come from one supply conveyor?

box_5.text: Check the indexing table regularly for faulty/damaged products

box_6.text: Empty the supply conveyor, check for deviations, then load a different batch of parts.

box_7.text: Check the reorientation unit and discharge assembly robot for deviations.

box_8.text: Notify maintenance team and quality assurance team
